name: Mornings lost to manager email
summary: Sorts the property manager's unread email into urgent, maintenance, owner, tenant, other and noise, drafts approved template replies for a person to approve, and leaves one morning summary as a Gmail draft. Crons read and draft; a person approves every reply before it is sent.

all.evidence: 2 of 4 calls read for this workflow describe the process step by step: a bot that sorts morning mail, and two VAs who handle maintenance email

covered_by.record-keeping: digest (summary draft); the property record is not built

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New unread mail from the manager's Gmail inbox, sorted by keyword rules. Noise is skipped.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Queue approved template replies for approval. Urgent mail and mail with no template are left for a person.

crons.name: digest
crons.summary: One summary draft of the mail not yet summarised, urgent first (20:30 UTC is 6:30 am in standard time and 7:30 am in daylight saving). Drafted only when there is new mail.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of unread inbox threads, a Gmail draft reply on the thread, a Gmail draft summary in the manager's mailbox. The only send is a reply, and it is queued for a person to approve.

google-workspace.covers: Gmail: read unread inbox threads, draft a reply on the thread, draft the morning summary, send a reply draft after approval

gaps: Console (now Reapit): help pages cover maintenance and the owner and tenant portals, but no operations are mapped in the kit, so no adapter.
PropertyMe: its help pages cover Messages, Reply with AiMe and Arrears Automation, but the kit lists no operations for it (gated: nothing public to map), so no adapter.
Outlook (Microsoft 365): the kit maps the Graph mail calls, but this job's evidence does not name the mailbox. Build an Outlook adapter once the business says it uses Outlook.

Maintenance requests: VaultRE and Re-Leased are mapped and hold maintenance and contact records, but no adapter writes a request to either. The maintenance step stays with the person who logs it today.
Property and tenancy lookup before a reply: VaultRE and Re-Leased are mapped for contacts and tenancies, but no lookup is built here.
Urgent mail: the keyword rules flag it and the digest puts it first. A person decides whether it is an emergency and who attends. Nothing here dispatches a tradesperson.
Trade chasing, owner approval of spend, escalation to a manager or after-hours on-call: judgment or unmapped steps, not automated.
Reply wording: the owner approves each template. Templates must not promise a date or a price.
The workflow has no alert when a cron stops. The call that described a morning bot stopping for days after it was moved is the reason to check the run log each morning.
Google Workspace is docs-only until a Gmail account proves the reads and drafts.

evidence.calls: 4 calls read for this workflow; 2 describe the process step by step (one bot that sorts morning email and flags urgent mail, one with two VAs handling maintenance email)
evidence.platforms: Console and PropertyMe help pages checked: neither has operations mapped in the kit, so Gmail is the only mailbox used; VaultRE and Re-Leased are mapped but no adapter is built for them
